title: Carbon Prices, Forest Conservation and Reforestation in the Brazilian Amazon
abstract: Deforestation for cattle ranching in the Brazilian Amazon emits carbon, and reforestation absorbs carbon. The social productivities for these alternative activities vary across locations. We analyze a spatial/dynamic model of efficient land allocation to establish a benchmark for policies. We treat cattle prices as stochastic and location-specific productivities as uncertain when assessing the consequences of imposing alternative prices of carbon emissions. Modest carbon price increases would incentivize Brazil to choose policies that capture a significant amount of greenhouse gases in the next 30 years. Our analysis pinpoints tropical forest management as an important contributor to climate change mitigation.
abstract_zh: 巴西亚马逊地区为发展牧牛业而进行的砍伐会排放碳，而重新造林则会吸收碳。这些替代性用途的社会生产率因地点而异。我们分析了一个高效土地配置的空间动态模型，以为政策确立基准。在评估施加不同碳排放价格的后果时，我们将牛价视为随机变量，并将地点特定的生产率视为不确定。适度提高碳价将激励巴西在未来30年内选择能够捕获大量温室气体的政策。我们的分析指出，热带森林管理是减缓气候变化的一个重要贡献因素。

title: Uncertainty, Social Valuation, and Climate Change Policy
abstract:
This paper explores how uncertainty, as it pertains to climate change challenges, operates through multiple channels and has impacts for the timing of responses. We use decision theory to embrace a broad notion of uncertainty and highlight its significance for forming robustly optimal policies. These prudent policies depend on social valuations such as the social cost of global warming and the social value of research and development. Drawing insights from stochastic response theory and asset pricing,
we assess when and why enhanced uncertainty concerns have important consequences for social valuation and lead to more proactive policy approaches to climate change.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了与气候变化挑战相关的不确定性如何通过多种渠道发挥作用，并对应对时机产生影响。我们运用决策理论来涵盖广义的不确定性概念，并强调其对形成稳健最优政策的重要性。这些审慎政策依赖于社会估值，例如全球变暖的社会成本以及研发的社会价值。借鉴随机响应理论和资产定价的见解，我们评估了增强的不确定性关切在何时以及为何会对社会估值产生重要影响，并导向对气候变化更为积极的政策方法。

title: Emission Prices, Biomass, and Biodiversity in Tropical Forests
venue: American Economic Review Papers and Proceedings, (May 2025) 115: 391–396
abstract: We investigate how external emission prices influence robustly optimal reforestation in the Brazilian Amazon and the biodiversity impacts. Extending the findings of Assuncao et al. (2023), we revisit their spatial-dynamic model of land allocation under uncertainty. Their analysis reveals that financial transfers of $25 per ton of CO2e can shift the Amazon from emitting 17 gigatons of CO2e to capturing 18 gigatons over 30 years. Our study expands this work by integrating scientific insights to evaluate biodiversity outcomes, highlighting the broader ecological benefits of emission pricing as a mechanism for achieving both carbon sequestration and biodiversity conservation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究外部排放价格如何影响巴西亚马逊地区稳健最优的再造林决策及其对生物多样性的影响。在Assuncao等人（2023）研究的基础上，我们重新审视了其在不确定性条件下的土地配置空间动态模型。他们的分析表明，每吨二氧化碳当量25美元的财政转移支付，可以使亚马逊地区在30年内从排放17吉吨二氧化碳当量转变为吸收18吉吨二氧化碳当量。本研究在此基础上纳入科学见解，以评估生物多样性的结果，并突出排放定价作为一种同时实现碳封存与生物多样性保护的机制所具有的更广泛生态效益。

title: A Deep Learning Analysis of Climate Change, Innovation, and Uncertainty
abstract: We study the implications of model uncertainty in a climate-economics framework with three types of capital: "dirty'' capital that produces carbon emissions when used for production, "clean'' capital that generates no emissions but is initially less productive than dirty capital, and knowledge capital that increases with R&D investment and leads to technological innovation in green sector productivity. To solve our high-dimensional, non-linear model framework we implement a neural-network-based global solution method. We show there are first-order impacts of model uncertainty on optimal decisions and social valuations in our integrated climate-economic-innovation framework. Accounting for interconnected uncertainty over climate dynamics, economic damages from climate change, and the arrival of a green technological change leads to substantial adjustments to investment in the different capital types in anticipation of technological change and the revelation of climate damage severity.
abstract_zh: 我们在一个包含三类资本的气候—经济学框架中研究模型不确定性的含义：一类是“肮脏”资本，用于生产时会排放碳；一类是“清洁”资本，不产生排放，但最初的生产率低于肮脏资本；还有知识资本，它随研发（R&D）投入而增长，并带来绿色部门生产率的技术创新。为求解这一高维非线性模型框架，我们采用了基于神经网络的全局求解方法。我们表明，在我们综合的气候—经济—创新框架中，模型不确定性对最优决策和社会估值存在一阶影响。在考虑气候动态、气候变化的经济损害以及绿色技术变革出现这三者之间相互关联的不确定性后，各类资本的投资需要根据对技术变革和气候损害严重程度披露的预期进行大幅调整。

title: Asset Pricing under Smooth Ambiguity in Continuous Time
Central Banking Challenges Posed by Uncertain Climate Change and Natural Disasters
abstract: Climate change poses an important policy challenge for governments around the world. The challenge is made all that much more difficult because of the multitude of potential policymakers involved in setting the policy worldwide. What then should be the role of central banks? How are climate change concerns similar to or distinct from those of other natural disasters? Clarity of ambition and execution will help to ensure that central banks maintain credibility. By adhering to their mandated roles, they retain their critically important distance from the political arena. Their credibility will be further enhanced by avoiding the temptation to exaggerate our understanding of climate change.
abstract_zh: 气候变化对世界各国政府构成了一项重要的政策挑战。由于全球制定政策的潜在决策者众多，这一挑战变得更加艰巨。那么，中央银行应当发挥什么作用？气候变化关切与其他自然灾害有何相似或不同之处？明确的目标和有效的执行将有助于确保中央银行保持公信力。通过恪守其法定职责，中央银行能够保持与政治领域至关重要的距离。避免夸大我们对气候变化的理解，将进一步增强其公信力。

title: Climate Change Uncertainty Spillover in the Macroeconomy
venue: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER) Macroeconomics Annual, (May 2022) 36: 253-320
abstract: The design and conduct of climate change policy necessarily confronts uncertainty along multiple fronts. We explore the consequences of ambiguity over various sources and configurations of models that impact how economic opportunities could be damaged in the future. We appeal to decision theory under risk, model ambiguity and misspecification concerns to provide an economically motivated approach to uncertainty quantification. We show how this approach reduces the many facets of uncertainty into a low dimensional characterization that depends on the uncertainty aversion of a decision-maker or fictitious social planner. In our computations, we take inventory of three alternative channels of uncertainty and provide a novel way to assess them. These include i) carbon dynamics that capture how carbon emissions impact atmospheric carbon in future time periods; ii) temperature dynamics that depict how atmospheric carbon alters temperature in future time periods; iii) damage functions that quantify how temperature changes diminish economic opportunities. We appeal to geoscientific modeling to quantify the first two channels. We show how these uncertainty sources interact for a social planner looking to design a prudent approach to the social pricing of carbon emissions.
abstract_zh: 气候变化政策的设计与实施必然在多个方面面临不确定性。我们探讨了关于各类模型来源及其组合的模糊性所产生的后果，这些模型影响未来经济机会可能受到的损害。我们借助风险、模型模糊性和设定错误关切下的决策理论，提供了一种基于经济动机的不确定性量化方法。我们展示了该方法如何将不确定性的诸多方面归约为一个低维表征，该表征取决于决策者或虚拟社会计划者的不确定性厌恶程度。在计算中，我们梳理了三条替代性的不确定性渠道，并提供了评估它们的一种新方法。这些渠道包括：i）碳动态，刻画碳排放如何影响未来各期的大气碳含量；ii）温度动态，描述大气碳如何改变未来各期的温度；iii）损害函数，量化温度变化如何削弱经济机会。我们借助地球科学建模来量化前两条渠道。我们展示了对于一个希望为碳排放的社会定价设计审慎方法的社会计划者而言，这些不确定性来源如何相互作用。

title: Macroeconomic Uncertainty Prices When Beliefs are Tenuous
Rational Policymaking During a Pandemic
Uncertainty Spillovers for Markets and Policy
Pricing Uncertainty Induced by Climate Change
abstract: Geophysicists examine and document the repercussions for the earth’s climate induced by alternative emission scenarios and model specifications. Using simplified approximations, they produce tractable characterizations of the associated uncertainty. Meanwhile, economists write highly stylized damage functions to speculate about how climate change alters macroeconomic and growth opportunities. How can we assess both climate and emissions impacts, as well as uncertainty in the broadest sense, in social decision-making? We provide a framework for answering this question by embracing recent decision theory and tools from asset pricing, and we apply this structure with its interacting components to a revealing quantitative illustration.
abstract_zh: 地球物理学家研究并记录了不同排放情景和模型设定对地球气候所造成的影响。他们使用简化近似，对相关的不确定性给出易于处理的刻画。与此同时，经济学家设定高度程式化的损害函数，以推测气候变化如何改变宏观经济和增长机会。我们如何在社会决策中，评估气候与排放的影响，以及最广义意义上的不确定性？我们借助近期的决策理论和资产定价工具，提供了回答这一问题的框架，并将这一包含相互作用各部分的结构应用于一个具有启发性的定量算例。

Aversion to Ambiguity and Model Misspecification in Dynamic Stochastic Environments
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America (PNAS), (August 2018) 115 (37), 9163-9168
abstract: In many dynamic economic settings, a decision maker finds it challenging to quantify the uncertainty or assess the potential for mistakes in models. We explore alternative ways of acknowledging these challenges by drawing on insights from decision theory as conceptualized in statistics, engineering, and economics. We suggest tractable and revealing ways to incorporate behavioral responses to uncertainty, broadly conceived. Our analysis adopts recursive intertemporal preferences for decision makers that allow them to be ambiguity averse and concerned about the potential misspecification of subjective uncertainty. By design, these representations have revealing implications for continuous time environments with Brownian information structures. Problems where uncertainty’s structure is obscure, such as macroeconomics, finance, and climate change, are promising areas for application of these tools.
abstract_zh: 在许多动态经济环境中，决策者很难量化不确定性或评估模型中可能出现的错误。我们借鉴统计学、工程学和经济学中对决策理论的概念化，探索了承认这些挑战的替代方式。我们提出了易于处理且具有启发性的方法，用以纳入对不确定性的行为反应，这一概念作广义理解。我们的分析对决策者采用递归跨期偏好，使其能够具有模糊厌恶，并关切主观不确定性可能存在的设定错误。通过这种设计，这些表示形式对于具有布朗信息结构的连续时间环境具有富有启发性的含义。在不确定性结构模糊的问题中，例如宏观经济学、金融学和气候变化，这些工具具有良好的应用前景。

title: Pricing Growth-Rate Risk
Proofs for Large Sample Properties of Generalized Method of Moments Estimators
Recursive Utility in a Markov Environment with Stochastic Growth
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, (July 2012), 109(30): 11967-72
abstract: Recursive utility models of the type introduced by Kreps and Porteus (1978) are used extensively in applied research in macroeconomics and asset pricing in environments with uncertainty. These models represent preferences as the solution to a nonlinear forward-looking difference equation with a terminal condition. Such preferences feature investor concerns about the intertemporal composition of risk. In this paper we study infinite horizon specifications of this difference equation in the context of a Markov environment. We establish a connection between the solution to this equation and to an arguably simpler Perron-Frobenius eigenvalue equation of the type that occurs in the study of large deviations for Markov processes. By exploiting this connection, we establish existence and uniqueness results. Moreover, we explore a substantive link between large deviation bounds for tail events for stochastic consumption growth and preferences induced by recursive utility.
abstract_zh: Kreps与Porteus（1978）提出的递归效用模型在不确定性环境下的宏观经济学和资产定价应用研究中被广泛使用。这类模型将偏好表示为一个带有终端条件的非线性前瞻性差分方程的解。此类偏好体现了投资者对风险跨期构成的关注。本文在马尔可夫环境下研究了该差分方程的无限期设定。我们建立了该方程的解与一个看似更简单的Perron–Frobenius特征值方程解之间的联系，后者常见于马尔可夫过程大偏差理论的研究中。利用这一联系，我们建立了解的存在性与唯一性结果。此外，我们探讨了随机消费增长尾部事件的大偏差界与递归效用所诱导的偏好之间的实质性联系。
